item.title: GMG G®CELLS long-life fast-charge cycling data
item.description:
Evidence: Preliminary (small-cell third-party test)

BIC-tested 1 Ah cells: 489 cycles at 10C/10C with no measured fade; LTO benchmark near end-of-life by ~64 cycles under the same profile. Energy density still being optimized.

Source: GMG

item.title: Directa G+ products
item.description:
Parent: [[reference/applications]] · [[topics/manufacturing/directa-plus]]

What leaves the plant

G+ = Directa’s pristine GNP family (plasma super-expansion of graphite, then water exfoliation in their process copy). Grades they name: MICRO/PURE G+ powders, PASTE/LIQUID dispersions, GRAFYSORBER super-expanded graphite.

Textiles and membranes

  • G+ Planar Thermal Circuit — printed circuit on fabric; heat-spread / IR story in company and Techtextil copy.
  • Padding/impregnation into viscose, cotton, denim — company: thermal, antistatic, antimicrobial language. Antimicrobial slogans are company claims, not a drug monograph here.
  • Membranes: GRAFYTHERM (G+ in ~20 µm water-based PU), GRAFYGUARD (that PU + PTFE), GRAFYOHM (conductive membrane). DTS acquisition 2016 in company copy.

GRAFYSORBER

Barriers, pillows, socks: fabric shell filled with super-expanded graphite. Company: absorb ~100× its weight, oil not water, press to recover hydrocarbon. Spill kit, not a graphene battery.

item.title: GMG THERMAL-XR
item.description:
Parent: [[reference/applications]] · [[topics/manufacturing/gmg]]

What it is

THERMAL-XR / THERMAL-XR ENHANCE: water-based acrylic with GMG graphene, sold as a coat for aluminium and copper air-cooled heat exchangers (RTPF and microchannel in product copy). Job they state: rebuild heat transfer on corroded coils, protect new ones, cut compressor work.

What they published

  • 9 Jul 2026 GMG release: >30,000 h ASTM B117-19 salt spray, no observed corrosion, external US lab (Industrial Inspection & Analysis in later product copy). Company comparison to 1,000–2,000 h class coatings is theirs.
  • Product site: heat-transfer work with University of Queensland; energy-savings tests at an ISO-accredited lab — attach those PDFs before treating % cuts as Well-supported.
  • Graphene-Info (radar): June 2026 order talk ~A$400k and a blending plant — Preliminary until the GMG release PDF is on the raise/order tape.

A coil coat is not a graphene battery and not a 4,000 t mill.

item.title: Haydale JustHeat
item.description:
Parent: [[reference/applications]] · [[topics/manufacturing/haydale]]

What it is

Haydale JustHeat: plasma-functionalised graphene ink printed on PET, silver bus bars, copper tape, PET laminate. Sits under a floor covering. 48 V class. Indoor dry use. Company: CE and UL in 2025 results copy.

Numbers on the install guide (V25)

  • Panel 600 × 530 mm (~0.31 m²)
  • 62 W ±10% per panel at 48 V; ~1.25 A; 200 W/m² ±10%
  • Max surface they state: 43 °C
  • Substrate PET 250 µm; top PET 75 µm
  • Ink: Haydale graphene-based heater ink + silver + copper tape

What stays company language

White paper (Mar 2025): demo-room modelling of large energy-cost and carbon cuts; “effective efficiency >100%” vs other systems on their comparison basis. That is Haydale’s model, not a utility tariff study on this page.

item.title: Haydale SETTF
item.description:
Evidence: Preliminary. Partner press, not a third-party TDS on this page.

Parent: [[reference/applications]] · [[topics/manufacturing/haydale]] · [[topics/industry/justheat]]

HDPlas-functionalised graphene heat-transfer fluid (SETTF). Haydale FY results: launched ~Nov 2025; commercial trials including data-centre cooling talk.

Levidian 14 Sep 2026 note: G3 graphene as the base carbon; test they state — ~28% higher thermal conductivity vs a fully inhibited glycol coolant, restoring that mix toward pure-water heat transfer while keeping freeze/corrosion package; live-silicon cooling run matched water on flow, pump power, die temperature in their wording; Liquitherm in the supply-chain sentence. Qualification and first deployments “next” in that note.

item.title: Late September 2026 catch-up
item.description:
Late September 2026

Gap fill after the site edits. Not a price list. Not advice. Graphene-Info lines are radar until a company PDF is cited.

Plants and orders

  • GMG Gen 2 plant, Queensland. Company said startup was on schedule before end of June 2026, budget at or under A$2.3 million, nameplate up to 10 tonnes a year after optimisation. Remaining powder and packing work was expected by end of September; self-power install by December. Preliminary (company statement, Australian Manufacturing 17 Sep 2026).
  • First Graphene × Pacific Urethanes. First production purchase order for PureGRAPH in mining polyurethane, fire-retardant loadings. Already on [[topics/manufacturing/pacific-urethanes]]. Company-stated order.
  • First Graphene × Vector. 36-month partner note for heat-flux sensors, reported 30 Sep 2026. Preliminary (Graphene-Info radar; no filing on this page yet).

Money

  • GMG private placement. About US$10 million, ~6.5 million shares at C$2.15, announced 23 Sep 2026, company said closed 29 Sep 2026. Use: graphene and battery capacity. Preliminary until the TSXV notice is filed here. Not a recommendation.
  • Volt Carbon Q3 2026. Reported revenue about C$4,945 and a net loss about C$806,000. Purchase-order talk of about US$4.1 million is mostly vermiculite tolling, not graphene tonnes. Preliminary.

Lab

  • Cortisol in saliva. University of the Bundeswehr Munich group reported a graphene transistor matching a lab test, posted 26 Sep 2026. One sensor paper. Not a clinical device. Preliminary.

Defence pool

  • Zentek. Pre-qualified for Canada’s Defense Drone Initiative supplier list, reported 26 Sep 2026. A pool listing is not a contract. Preliminary.

item.title: Sparc × HydroGraph coatings
item.description:
Evidence: Preliminary. Issuer case study / ASX-style notice via trade recap. Not an independent lab PDF attached here.

Parent: [[reference/applications]] · [[topics/manufacturing/hydrograph]]

Sparc ecosparc additive + HydroGraph FGA-1 fractal graphene in protective coats.

HydroGraph case study (water-based ecosparc, ISO 9227 NSS), company figures:

  • scribe-creep cut 60% at 480 h, 39% at 960 h, 59% at 1,680 h vs unmodified
  • blistering reduced from 960 h; FGA-1 best of the grades they ran at 1,680 h
  • scribe ~0.27–0.28 mm at each interval in that writeup

Apr 2025 HydroGraph PU-topcoat note (separate): 0 / 0.05 / 0.1 / 0.5% in commercial PU; abrasion / scratch / UV % are that release.

item.title: Universal Matter Genable Pavement
item.description:
Evidence: Preliminary on durability claims. The lays are named.

Parent: [[reference/applications]] · [[topics/manufacturing/universal-matter]]

Genable Pavement = UM graphene additive in asphalt (ex-AGM UK / Redcar).

Named lays (council 3 Mar 2025 + later APSE slide):

  • Flatts Lane Country Park entrance (Redcar & Cleveland) — first UK public road in that press; Tarmac Coxhoe plant; ~150–200 t asphalt depending on the writeup
  • Pennyman Walk, Marske-by-the-Sea — ~180 t
  • US/Canada car parks and NCAT test-track language on UM product page; Minnesota Route 12 “3-mile section” in the APSE slide

Company product page: 3.0 wt% of asphalt cement, dry add, “two PG bumps / 12 °C” vs SBS talk; NCAT acceptance of a section (May 2024 Phase 1; pave fall 2024; monitor into 2026). Those metrics stay company/slide until the NCAT table is attached.

item.title: Zentek ZenGUARD
item.description:
ASHRAE numbers: Preliminary (company recap of a test). Health Canada classification: dated release.

Parent: [[reference/applications]] · [[topics/manufacturing/zentek]]

ZenGUARD is a coating on a substrate. HVAC filter media and surgical masks / air-contact surfaces.

Regulatory

  • Brand 13 Apr 2021. Canadian patent PPE + HVAC granted 6 Dec 2022 (term to 20 Sep 2041) in later SEC text.
  • 29 Nov 2021 — Health Canada MDEL 18823, Class I including coated devices.
  • 6 May 2026 — PRD: Enhanced Air Filters not under the Pest Control Products Act; s. 3(1)(a) mechanical mode of action; conditional on design, instructions, marketing. Company then accepting Canadian filter orders.

ASHRAE 52.2 (company)

6 May 2026 materials: media tested to ASHRAE 52.2; MERV 9 with pressure drop they say matches uncoated media at standard and high airflow. The lab report file is not on this shelf. The ASHRAE standard PDF is a paid method document, not their result sheet.
